meta.description: Workflow tái sử dụng: probe ISSUE_KEY_URL trước (HTTP HEAD), nếu alive thì dùng, nếu lỗi fallback WEB_BASE_URL. Đăng nhập thật bằng TRADING_USERNAME/PASSWORD, dump DOM, lưu locators.json.

nodes.name: 3. Probe URL -> Playwright Login & DOM Discovery

parameters.jsCode:
const d = $input.first().json;
const probeInfo = d.probeStatus
  ? `probe(${d.issueKeyUrl})=${d.probeStatus.status||d.probeStatus.reason} -> dùng: ${d.urlSource}`
  : '';
const out = {
  issueKey: d.issueKey, targetPage: d.targetPage,
  resolvedUrl: d.resolvedUrl, urlSource: d.urlSource,
  issueKeyUrl: d.issueKeyUrl, webBaseUrl: d.webBaseUrl,
  probeStatus: d.probeStatus,
  loginSuccess: d.loginSuccess, locatorCount: d.locatorCount,
  outputFile: d.outputFile,
  screenshotBefore: d.screenshotBefore, screenshotAfter: d.screenshotAfter,
  success: d.success,
  message: d.success
    ? `[WebUILocator] ✅ ${d.locatorCount} locators cho '${d.targetPage}' (${probeInfo}) -> ${d.outputFile}`
    : `[WebUILocator] ❌ Thất bại: login=${d.loginSuccess}, exitCode=${d.exitCode} | ${probeInfo} | err=${d.stderr?.slice(0,200)}`,
  errors: d.locatorsData?.errors || [],
  capturedAt: d.locatorsData?.capturedAt || new Date().toISOString(),
  login_locators: d.locatorsData?.locators?.login || {},
  page_locators: (d.locatorsData?.locators?.[d.targetPage] || []).slice(0, 50)
};
return [{ json: out }];

const inp = $input.first().json;
return [{ json: { success: false, message: inp.error || '[WebUILocator] Input validation failed', issueKey: inp.issueKey||'', targetPage: inp.targetPage||'' } }];
